question: What understanding has been attained through the grace of the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge has arisen by his grace
The object known is the determination of Kaula
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O lord of Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
